summary:
Qualified Company Secretary with over a decade of experience in corporate governance, regulatory
compliances, FEMA filings, secretarial standards, and board support. Experienced in handling end-to-end
processes under the Companies Act, FEMA, and corporate governance audits. Earlier exposure to SEBI and
listed company compliances, with current focus on board and shareholder processes, FEMA filings, related
party compliance, and regulatory reporting. Recognized for a structured, solution-oriented approach and
the ability to maintain composure under high-pressure compliance timelines.

skills._method: flashtext_skills_section | fuzzy(ROC Filings→ROC Filing(95%), Corporate Governance Audits→Corporate Law(95%), regulatory compliances→Regulatory Compliance(98%), reporting.→Reporting(95%))

bullets: Ensured compliance under Companies Act, FEMA, and Secretarial Standards across group entities.

Drafted agendas, notices, minutes, and governance documents.

Contributed to preparation of annual reports and corporate disclosures.

Conducted Board and General Meetings and prepared statutory documents.

Managed the private placement process.
